register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute, with no long form.

backoffice.title: Backoffice
backoffice.presetsLead: Create looks for the whole platform. Publish them so every brand can pick them in the gallery.
backoffice.newKindLead: Each type has its own lab. Pick one to start. New types, such as video, will get their own screen later.
backoffice.name: Name key
backoffice.nameHint: Dash-separated i18n key, for example presets.avatar. The wording lives in the pt-BR and en files.
backoffice.promptImageHint: Write the image prompt and tap the buttons below to insert brand data. The visual style stays consistent across clients; the data personalizes each result.
backoffice.promptTextHint: Write the caption prompt and insert brand data. Generate text separately from the image.
backoffice.resultTextHint: Last caption result saved with this look.
backoffice.phonePreviewHint: How the post looks on Instagram: image on top, caption below.
backoffice.phoneEmptyImage: Generate the image to see it here
backoffice.phoneEmptyCaption: Generate the caption to see it here
backoffice.includeLogoHint: Tells the AI to leave a clear corner for the real logo, which is composited later.
backoffice.includeLogoSingleHint: The brand logo sits in the chosen corner. Slide text stays out of that area.
backoffice.logoPlacementHint: Pick the corner. The resolved prompt and preview ask the AI to avoid that area.
backoffice.logoPlacementSingleHint: Pick the corner. Slide text stays out of that band.
backoffice.labBrandHint: Any brand in this environment. Only used so you can generate and preview this look in the lab (name, colors, logo). Customers always use their own brand in the product.
backoffice.labProductHint: Values for '{{product.name}}', '{{product.price}}', and '{{product.description}}' in the image and caption. Saved on this look for the lab.
backoffice.labTopicHint: On generate, the AI researches the web from the brand, picks the topic, and builds a carousel (3–5) or a single image — per the format choice. Caption follows with a soft CTA to visit or get in touch.
backoffice.labTopicAutoHint: On generate, the AI researches the web from the brand, writes the slide script and caption, and builds the carousel (or single image) in one go.
backoffice.labTopicEmptyResult: No topic yet. Click Generate — research, script and images run together.
backoffice.labDeckScriptHint: Created with the images. At the top: format (carousel or single), slides and theme (dark, light or random). Below: brand colors, fonts and logos. Edit and save if you want; click Generate again for a new topic.
backoffice.labDeckScriptEmpty: The slide script shows up here after Generate.
backoffice.labThemeHint: Light uses the brand background and the regular logo. Dark uses the main color and the inverted logo. Random picks when images are rendered.
backoffice.resolvedPromptHint: How the prompt looks with the selected brand. The saved text stays the same.
backoffice.resolvedPromptEmpty: Write the prompt and select a brand to see the result.
backoffice.saveBeforeGenerate: Save the look before generating with the brand and reference images.
backoffice.refLocationHint: Optional. One photo of the place/environment where the scene happens.
backoffice.refLocationOptional: Without a location, the AI invents the setting.
backoffice.refPeopleHint: Up to 3 photos. Each photo must be a different person — the AI keeps each identity.
backoffice.refPeopleHintAvatar: Up to 3 photos of the SAME person (different angles or outfits). On generate, one photo is chosen at random.
backoffice.refProductsHint: Up to 3 photos of the SAME product (different angles or details). The AI keeps that product.
backoffice.refUploadNewHint: You can pick the photos now. They upload when you create the look.
backoffice.enabledHint: When checked, customers see this look in the gallery when creating ads. Unchecked keeps it as a backoffice draft only.
backoffice.deleteConfirm: Delete this look? It leaves the gallery and the lab. Ads already created from it stay saved.
backoffice.empty: No looks yet. Create the first one in the lab.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyOrg: Add your company to get started.
dashboard.emptyBrand: Now add the brand. We will read its website.
dashboard.metricsLead: Nothing is published yet. Numbers show up when there are ads.

brands.title: Brands
brands.empty: No brands yet. Create the first one.
brands.removeConfirm: Delete this brand? It leaves the list. Ads already created stay saved.

brandEditor.name: Name
brandEditor.removeConfirm: Delete this brand? It leaves the list. Ads already created stay saved.
brandEditor.segmentHint: The crawl can refine this while it stays on automatic. Changing it locks the choice.

visual.title: Visual identity
visual.lead: Colors, fonts, and logos read from the site. What you change stays on the next reading.
visual.marksLead: Upload up to two logos. When creating an ad you choose which one to use.
visual.emptyImages: Upload images or scan the site to bring them in.

creation.title: Creation
creation.createModeLead: Start from a ready-made model or build your own.
creation.readyModelsLead: It is already set up. You pick one and can change the name.
creation.customizeLead: You set the tone, the text, the image, and the logo.
creation.needBrand: Create a brand before setting up ad models.
creation.modelsLead: The model says how the ad should be written and how the image should look. It is used when you create one now and when ads are automatic.
creation.manualLead: Ads generated from looks. Open one to view, edit, or publish.
creation.manualNotFound: Ad not found for this brand.
creation.creatingNoticeLead: This usually takes about a minute. You can leave this screen open.
creation.manualGeneratingFooter: This usually takes about a minute. You can leave this screen open.

manualGeneratingBeats.1: Looking for a way for {brand} to talk like a person…
manualGeneratingBeats.2: Writing text that does not sound like a generic ad…
manualGeneratingBeats.3: Building an image that looks like {brand}…
manualGeneratingBeats.4: Tuning contrast, logo, and the last detail…
manualGeneratingBeats.5: Almost there — {brand}'s next ad is taking shape.

creation.manualDeleteConfirm: Delete this ad? It leaves the list. Published ads cannot be deleted.
creation.manualPublishLead: Choose which networks should receive this draft.
creation.manualPublishNeedCredential: Tap here to connect LinkedIn and publish on this network.
creation.manualPublishNeedInstagramCredential: Tap here to connect Instagram and publish on this network.
creation.manualPublishNeedPageUrn: LinkedIn is connected. Choose the company page below.
creation.manualPublishReadOnly: This ad is already published and cannot be edited.
creation.manualPublishNetworkFailed: This network could not be published.
creation.viewNetworksLead: Tap a network to connect. Where this ad already went out, and where it has not.
creation.automationLead: Pick the look, day, and time. At that minute the system creates one unique draft from that look. Nothing is published on its own.
creation.automationNeedPreset: No published looks yet. An administrator needs to publish looks in the backoffice.
creation.automationHint: The time uses the brand time zone ({timezone}). If the server is away for a few minutes, it still creates the ad up to 20 minutes later. The same slot does not create two ads on the same day.
creation.automationLogsEmpty: No logs yet. They show up when a time runs, including when creation fails.
creation.comingSoon: This screen is ready. The next step is generating the ads.
creation.emptyModels: No models yet. Create one to say how ads should sound and look.
creation.name: Name
creation.structureLead: Set the order of the text. Use the arrows to change the order.
creation.ctaType: What to ask at the end
creation.imageLocale: Language of the text on the image
creation.logoBackdropPaddingHint: Inner margin: {value}% of the logo size
creation.logoBackdropOffsetDrag: Drag the logo in the background
creation.logoBackdropPreview: Preview of the logo on the background
creation.logoBackdropPreviewHint: Drag the logo or use the controls to place it inside the background.
creation.imageNotesPlaceholder: e.g. a real clinic, daylight, no generic stock photo

fieldHints.presets: Fills in the tone, the text order, and the goal. You can change everything afterward.
fieldHints.name: Model name in the list. It does not appear on the published ad.
fieldHints.description: Short summary of what this model should say. It helps keep the right subject.
fieldHints.status: Active can be used to generate ads. Inactive stays hidden from the choices.
fieldHints.format: Piece type. Today it makes one ad with one image. Carousel and story come later.
fieldHints.purpose: What this ad should achieve, such as teaching, talking, or selling.
fieldHints.tones: Way of speaking. Pick a few so the text does not mix styles.
fieldHints.intensity: How much the text pushes what it wants to say.
fieldHints.guidanceDont: What the AI should avoid, such as stock phrases, tone, or forbidden subjects.
fieldHints.structure: Text order, in parts. That order guides the caption.
fieldHints.ctaType: What to ask at the end of the text.
fieldHints.ctaInstruction: Optional detail of the ask. For example: invite a question in the comments.
fieldHints.visualStyles: Look you want for the image.
fieldHints.imageUsage: Whether the ad needs an image. With none, only the text is generated.
fieldHints.composition: What shows more: the image or the text.
fieldHints.peopleMode: Says whether people may appear and whether they must follow the brand guidance.
fieldHints.imageNotes: Image details so it does not look generic.
fieldHints.includeLogo: Puts the real brand logo on the final image.
fieldHints.logoVariant: Which logo file to use: normal, for dark backgrounds, or automatic.
fieldHints.logoBackdrop: Draws a colored shape behind the logo so it shows up better.
fieldHints.logoBackdropColor: Color of the background behind the logo.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShape: Background shape, such as a circle or a rounded rectangle.
fieldHints.logoBackdropPadding: Space between the background edge and the logo.
fieldHints.logoBackdropOffsetX: Moves the logo left (−) or right (+) inside the background.
fieldHints.logoBackdropOffsetY: Moves the logo up (−) or down (+) inside the background.
fieldHints.logoBackdropOpacity: How much the background shows on the photo. 10% is almost invisible and 100% is clearly visible.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShadow: Adds a soft shadow behind the background so the logo stands out.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShadowOpacity: Shadow strength. 0 is invisible and 100 is clearly marked.
fieldHints.logoBackdropShadowBlur: How far the shadow spreads. 0 is sharp and 40 is very soft.

creation.previewHint: Colors, fonts, and logo come from the brand visual identity. Nothing is published from this screen.
creation.removeConfirm: Delete this model? It leaves the list. Drafts already made stay saved.

sections.cta: What to ask at the end

peopleModes.scene: People are OK, following the brand guidance

presetNames.question: Ask the people who follow you

presetBlurbs.conversation: Talks with people and invites a reply.
presetBlurbs.teach: Explains one useful idea in short steps.
presetBlurbs.expert: Shows a clear point of view on the subject.
presetBlurbs.product: Presents the product and invites people to learn more, without pressure.
presetBlurbs.product_humor: Talks about the product lightly, without joking about the customer.
presetBlurbs.contact: Invites the right person to get in touch.
presetBlurbs.question: Asks a clear question, without pushing a sale.
presetBlurbs.clean: A strong image and a very short caption.

outputKindLead.product: Show a product or service from brand facts.
outputKindLead.avatar: Speak as a person from the brand.
outputKindLead.market_topic: Teach a market topic the brand already covers.

creation.galleryLead: Pick a look for this type.
creation.needSegment: This brand needs a segment before the gallery opens.

wizard.title: Start creating
wizard.needOrg: Add your company before creating an ad.
wizard.welcomeLead: We read the site, you pick a look, and we generate a draft you can edit.
wizard.scanProgressLead: We are building the name, profile, and visuals. You can leave this screen open.
wizard.scanReadyLead: Now pick the type of the ad.
wizard.scanRetryLead: We could not read the site. Try again.
wizard.siteLead: Choose which brand this ad will speak for.
wizard.galleryEmpty: There are no published looks for this brand yet.
wizard.newBrandScanLead: We read the page and build the name, profile, and visuals.
wizard.newBrandLooksLikeName: That looks like a name. Create without a site?
wizard.newBrandNoSite: No website? Create with a name
wizard.newBrandManualLead: Add the name. Profile and visuals live on the brand page.
wizard.newBrandPreferScan: I would rather scan a site
wizard.manualReady: Brand created. Open the brand to finish the profile, or continue.
wizard.brandLead: This comes from the Brand Brain. Continue, or customize the segment, profile, and visuals.
wizard.kindLead: Only types with a published look appear here.
wizard.kindEmpty: There is no published look yet. Come back when the lab publishes one.
wizard.kindComingSoon: This type does not generate ads yet. The look already exists in the lab.
wizard.galleryLeadKind: Pick a {kind} look. Tap to see it on the phone.
wizard.galleryPreviewHint: Tap a look to see it on the phone.
wizard.previewTitle: How it looks on the phone
wizard.tuneLead: Optionally adjust how this ad should be written, then generate the draft.
wizard.promptVsBrand: This text guides the ad. Company facts and visuals still come from the Brand Brain.
wizard.guidanceDo: What to do in this ad
wizard.guidanceDont: What to avoid in this ad

prepareLead.avatar: Add photos of the person and, if you want, the place. The chosen look sets the style; these photos are your parameter.
prepareLead.product: Enter this brand’s product. The chosen look is the mold; name, price, description, and photos are the AI parameters.
prepareLead.carousel: We will research a topic from this brand and build the carousel with the chosen look. Nothing else to fill in.
prepareLead.single: We will research a topic from this brand and build the single piece with the chosen look.

wizard.prepareLogoHint: The brand mark goes in the reserved corner if you want it.
wizard.productPricePlaceholder: How it should appear in the ad
wizard.resultLead: Check the result and publish on the networks you want.
wizard.automateLead: Want to schedule a weekly post so you keep showing up for your customers?
wizard.automateHint: Each generation is a different result. The same look makes a new ad every time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.supportedHint: Check the languages this company can use. The default language stays selected.

users.title: Users
users.passwordHint: The password is required only for someone who does not have an account yet. Someone who already has an account joins without changing the password.
users.removeConfirm: Remove this user from the company?

errors.email_taken: That email is already in use.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.crawl_failed: We could not read that site. Try another address.
errors.openai_failed: The automatic analysis failed. Try again.
errors.openai_quota: The OpenAI account has no credits. Add credits to that account and try again.
errors.openai_rejected: OpenAI did not accept the key. Check the key under AI and try again.
errors.stale: The previous analysis is out of date. Try again.
errors.profile_unconfirmed: Confirm the brand profile before generating ideas.
errors.unsupported_locale: This brand language needs an OpenAI key in use, under AI.
errors.not_enough_material: The profile does not have enough subjects for a calendar.
errors.plan_failed: The calendar could not be built. Try again.
errors.queue_failed: The calendar could not be started. Try again.
errors.ai_unconfigured: There is no AI ready yet. Under AI, paste the OpenAI key and mark it as the one in use.
errors.provider_unavailable: The chosen AI does not write content yet. Choose OpenAI to use it now.
errors.schedule_taken: That look is already set for this day and time.
errors.invalid_timezone: The brand time zone is not valid.
errors.automation_queue_failed: The ad was created, but it did not enter the generation queue.
errors.encryption_unconfigured: Passwords cannot be saved right now. Try again later.
errors.forbidden: Only someone who runs the organization can do that.
errors.already_member: That person is already in the organization.
errors.last_owner: The organization needs at least one owner.
errors.integration_unconfigured: That network is not connected yet. Set it up under Integrations.
errors.linkedin_failed: LinkedIn refused to publish on the company page. Allow publishing as the company on LinkedIn, connect again, and try once more.
errors.instagram_failed: Instagram refused to publish. Check the professional account, the Meta app, and that images are on a public HTTPS URL, then try again.
errors.facebook_failed: Facebook refused to publish. Check the Page, the Meta app permissions, and that images are on a public HTTPS URL, then try again.
errors.invalid_state: The connection expired. Try connecting again.
errors.network_unavailable: That network cannot publish in this version yet.

brandBrain.empty: Read the website so we can build the profile from the text already published.
brandBrain.peopleGuidanceHint: e.g. a blonde doctor, the founder. Do not invent other people. Used when the look allows people in the image.

brandBrain.listHint: One item per line. Leave empty when the site does not say.
brandBrain.sourceOpenai: Read by the AI from the site text
